name: Shobi
bio: Shobi son of Nahash was from Rabbah of the Ammonites — likely a brother of Hanun, the king who had humiliated David's envoys years before. When David reached Mahanaim, exhausted from fleeing Absalom's rebellion, Shobi joined Machir son of Ammiel and Barzillai the Gileadite in bringing beds, bowls, pottery, wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, honey, curds, sheep, and cheese for David and his famished, weary people (2 Samuel 17:27-29).
